channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Democrats won Congress. But can they deliver on their promises?
item.description: Despite their midterm election victories, Democrats face major obstacles to reining in Trump on Iran, tariffs and more.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says two oil tankers and tugboat caught fire in Hormuz
item.description: Iran's IRGC says two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after using an "unauthorised route".

item.title: Giant banner of Trump, Vance and Netanyahu burnt at Tehran rally
item.description: A giant banner depicting US President Donald Trump and Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was burnt in Tehran

item.title: Trump blames Iran war for midterms losses
item.description: President Donald Trump said the war in Iran likely contributed to Republican setbacks in the midterm elections

item.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
item.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

item.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
item.description: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

item.title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
item.description: Authorities in British Columbia say evidence suggests an animal may have been involved in the women's deaths.

item.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
item.description: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

item.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
item.description: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

item.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
item.description: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.
